settings.overviewDescription: Configure how this server's currency works, including earning, transfers and the role shop.

reasons.transfersOff: Turn Transfers on to use this

descriptions.active: Turn the currency system on or off for this server.
descriptions.frozen: Pause all earning and spending without losing configuration.
descriptions.currencyName: The name members will see for this server's currency.
descriptions.currencyEmote: The icon shown next to amounts of the currency.
descriptions.startBalance: The amount every member begins with.
descriptions.maxBalance: The highest balance a member can hold; zero means no limit.
descriptions.balancePublic: Let anyone view another member's balance.
descriptions.leaderboardPublic: Let anyone view the server leaderboard.
descriptions.logChannels: Channels that receive balance change logs.
descriptions.messageAmount: Currency earned per message. Zero switches chat earning off.
descriptions.messageCooldown: Seconds a member must wait between earning messages.
descriptions.messageDailyCap: Most a member can earn per day from chatting; zero means no limit.
descriptions.minTenureHours: Hours a member must have been known to this server before they can earn, as an anti-alt measure.
descriptions.allowChannels: If set, only these channels allow earning.
descriptions.allowRoles: If set, only these roles can earn.
descriptions.allowUsers: If set, only these members can earn.
descriptions.transferActive: Allow members to send currency to each other.
descriptions.transferMin: Smallest amount a transfer can be.
descriptions.transferMax: Largest amount a transfer can be; zero means no limit.
descriptions.transferDailyMax: Most a member can transfer per day; zero means no limit.
descriptions.botToken: Bot token used for this feature.
descriptions.profileNick: The name this bot shows under in this server. Shared with every feature using the same bot. Leave empty to use its default name.
descriptions.profileAvatar: A Discord CDN image link for this bot's avatar in this server. Leave empty to remove it.
descriptions.profileBanner: A Discord CDN image link for this bot's banner in this server. Leave empty to remove it.
descriptions.profileBio: Short bio on the bot profile in this server. Discord does not report it back, so this box always looks empty even once set.

rewards.overviewDescription: Pay a one-off currency bonus the first time a Member qualifies for a Reward. Each Reward pays once per Member, so re-gaining a qualifying Role does not pay again.
rewards.section: Who qualifies for this Reward, and how much currency it pays out.

descriptions.active: Whether this Reward is evaluated at all. Turning it off stops any further payouts from it.
descriptions.roles: Holding any one of these Roles qualifies a Member for this Reward.
descriptions.denyRoles: Holding any one of these Roles disqualifies a Member, even if they hold a qualifying Role.
descriptions.denyUsers: These Users never qualify for this Reward, even while holding a qualifying Role.
descriptions.currency: How much currency to pay the first time a Member qualifies. Set 0 to pay nothing.
descriptions.xpMultiplier: Multiplies the XP a qualifying Member earns. 1 leaves XP unchanged.
descriptions.payEvery: Days a Member must hold the Role before each payout. Zero pays only on receive.
descriptions.repeating: Keep paying every interval. Turn this off to pay once after the first interval.
descriptions.recurringAmount: What the first recurring payout is worth. Later payouts follow the curve.
descriptions.curve: How the recurring amount grows with each payout. Flat amounts use Linear.
descriptions.curveModifier: How steep the curve is. Higher climbs faster. The default is 100.
descriptions.buyPrice: What a Member pays in server currency. Zero means it cannot be bought.
descriptions.purchaseRoles: Roles handed to the buyer. Qualifying Roles only decide who may buy.
descriptions.customRoleReward: Unlock a Custom-Role Reward when this is bought.
descriptions.shopType: Where Members buy this. Either the Shop command, or a Panel you post yourself.
descriptions.panelChannel: Pick a Channel and the Panel is posted there right away. This field clears itself.
descriptions.panelButtonText: Label shown on the buy Button.
descriptions.panelButtonEmote: Icon shown on the buy Button.
descriptions.panelEmbed: Name of a saved Embed to use as the Panel body. Clears the components choice.
descriptions.panelComponents: Name of a saved Component set to use as the Panel body. Clears the embed choice.

rewards.payoutSection: When this Reward pays out, and how the amount grows over time.
rewards.recurringSection: How a repeating payout grows over time.
rewards.previewDescription: See what the next 25 payouts are worth.
rewards.previewNeedsRecurring: Set a recurring amount and an interval first.
rewards.shopSection: What this Reward costs and what the buyer gets.

rewards.panelBody: Buy this Reward to unlock what it grants.
rewards.postFailed: Could not post the Panel in {{channel}}. Check my permissions there.
rewards.needsPrice: Set a purchase price before posting a Panel.
rewards.shopFooter: Change what this Panel says with {{command}}.
rewards.needsActive: Switch this Reward on before posting a Panel.
rewards.panelSection: The Panel Members press to buy this Reward.
